awayFromOauth: The probe found OAuth. Pick API key if this server also accepts a key you already have.
awayFromNone: The server answered without a key. Add one if your plan gives you a key for higher limits.
oauthUnavailable: OAuth is available when the server offers OAuth sign-in.
usernameColon: A username cannot contain a colon.
basicHint: Encoded once and stored as one project secret. The username and password are not kept.
headerSchemeHint: This server asked for the {{scheme}} scheme.
basicPrefixHint: What goes in front of the secret. Basic expects username:password encoded once; the helper below does that.
noPrefixHint: The secret is sent as the header value with nothing in front of it.
name: Name
headerHelp: The HTTP header this server expects, for example x-api-key
authMethodPost: Send the secret in the request body
authMethodBasic: Send the secret with Basic authentication
ownOauthAppNotice: This server needs an OAuth app you register yourself. Add the callback URL to it, then paste its client ID and secret.
clientHelp: Only needed when the server does not register clients on its own. Most do.
copyByHand: Select the URL and copy it.
scopesHelp: Uncheck a scope to ask for less.
addServerSubtitle: Pick a connected server, or connect a new one.
noServersYet: No MCP servers in this project yet
noServersYetBody: Connect an MCP server by URL. You'll sign in or add a key once, and every agent in the project can use it.
